hr-consulting.title: HR Consulting
hr-consulting.subtitle: Build a stronger, compliant, and well-managed HR system - without hiring a full HR team.
hr-consulting.intro: We help companies build clear, compliant, and practical HR systems. Many growing companies struggle with HR because there is no structure - no clear policies, no proper contracts, no performance system, and no one to handle compliance. That creates risk, confusion, and high turnover. Our HR consulting service fixes that. We review your current HR setup, find the gaps, and build a system that works for your size, industry, and workforce. We do not give you a generic file of policies. We build policies, processes, and tools your team can actually use every day. We work with startups, SMEs, and large companies across the UAE and Qatar. Whether you have ten employees or five hundred, we help you manage people better, stay compliant, and reduce HR problems before they become legal or financial issues.

cards.title: HR Audit & Gap Analysis
cards.body: We review your contracts, policies, files, payroll, attendance, and compliance. You get a clear report showing what is missing, what is risky, and what to fix first.

cards.title: HR Policies & Employee Handbook
cards.body: We create clear policies for leave, attendance, discipline, grievance, working hours, and code of conduct. Written in simple language, aligned with UAE and Qatar labour law.

cards.title: Employment Contracts & Documentation
cards.body: We prepare compliant employment contracts, offer letters, warning letters, and HR forms. All documents are ready to use and easy to update.

cards.title: Payroll Structure & Grading
cards.body: We help you build fair salary structures, grades, allowances, and increments. This helps you control cost, retain good staff, and avoid salary confusion.

cards.title: Performance Management System
cards.body: We build simple KPI and appraisal systems. Managers can set targets, review performance, and give feedback without complicated paperwork.

cards.title: Compliance & Labour Law Support
cards.body: We guide you on WPS, visa, labour cards, end-of-service, and inspection readiness. We help you stay compliant and avoid fines and disputes.

steps.title: Share Your HR Challenge
steps.body: Tell us what is not working - policies, payroll, compliance, turnover, or all of it.

steps.title: We Audit Your HR
steps.body: We review your current documents, processes, and compliance.

steps.title: We Build Your HR System

steps.title: We Train & Support
steps.body: We train your managers and support you until the system is running.

faqs.q: What is HR consulting and do I need it?
faqs.a: If you have no clear policies, no proper contracts, high turnover, or confusion about leave, salary, or discipline, you need HR consulting. It helps you build structure before problems grow.

faqs.q: How long does an HR audit take?
faqs.a: For most SMEs, an audit takes one to two weeks. For larger companies, it depends on number of employees and locations. We share a timeline before we start.

faqs.q: Will the policies be compliant with UAE / Qatar labour law?
faqs.a: Yes. All policies and contracts are prepared to align with local labour law and best practice for your industry and workforce type.

faqs.q: Do you also handle payroll after consulting?
faqs.a: Yes. If you want, we can also manage payroll, WPS, and ongoing HR support after the consulting project. Many clients continue with us for payroll and manpower.

faqs.q: Can you train our managers on the new system?
faqs.a: Yes. We provide training for managers and HR staff on how to use the new policies, appraisal system, and HR processes.

faqs.q: Do you work with companies that have no HR team?
faqs.a: Yes. Most of our clients have no full HR team. We act as your HR partner and build a system your admin or operations team can manage easily.

cleaning-facilities-staffing.title: Cleaning & Facilities Staffing
cleaning-facilities-staffing.subtitle: Clean, trained, and reliable facility staff for buildings, offices, and malls.
cleaning-facilities-staffing.intro: We supply trained cleaning and facility staff for buildings, offices, malls, hospitals, schools, and residential communities. Cleanliness is not just about appearance. It is about health, safety, and first impression. A dirty office, lobby, or washroom damages your brand in seconds. That is why we focus on training, hygiene, and supervision. Our team understands facility operations. We know the difference between a cleaner who follows a checklist and one who just mops. We train staff on chemicals, machines, hygiene, and safety. Every worker is supervised and checked regularly so your facility stays clean every day. We work with facility management companies, building owners, malls, offices, hospitals, schools, and hotels across the UAE and Qatar. From daily cleaning to full facility teams, we build a staffing plan that fits your site, shift, and cleaning scope.

cards.title: General Cleaners

cards.title: Housekeeping Staff
cards.body: Housekeeping staff for hotels, apartments, and serviced offices. Room cleaning, bed making, and hygiene standards.

cards.title: Deep Cleaning & Specialised Cleaning
cards.body: Deep cleaning teams for kitchens, carpets, facades, and post-construction cleaning. Trained on machines and chemicals.

cards.title: Facility Helpers & Technicians
cards.body: Facility helpers, maintenance helpers, and technicians for buildings. Basic maintenance, plumbing, electrical, and AC support.

cards.title: Security & Support Staff
cards.body: Support staff for buildings, including lobby staff, helpers, and site support. Groomed, disciplined, and shift-ready.

cards.title: Supervisors & Team Leaders
cards.body: Facility supervisors who manage cleaning teams, check quality, control attendance, and report daily to your manager.

construction-contract-staffing.title: Construction & Contract Staffing
construction-contract-staffing.subtitle: Project-ready trade and site teams planned around your programme and site requirements.
construction-contract-staffing.intro: Construction staffing means planning the people, trades, shifts, and start dates required to keep a project moving. We work with contractors and project teams to define the roles, quantities, experience, location, and expected duration before sourcing begins. That brief helps distinguish general helpers from skilled trades and makes it easier to plan who needs to be available at each project stage. We support contract and project staffing for employers across construction, infrastructure, fit-out, and maintenance. The exact workforce plan depends on candidate availability, site access, applicable approvals, and the responsibilities agreed with your company. Before deployment, we confirm the scope and required documents with your nominated site contact.

cards.title: General site helpers
cards.body: Helpers for material movement, site preparation, loading, and other general duties. We confirm work conditions, shifts, and physical requirements in the brief.

cards.title: Skilled construction trades
cards.body: Masons, carpenters, steel fixers, painters, electricians, and plumbers can be considered against the skills and experience each project requires.

cards.title: Technicians and maintenance
cards.body: Technicians and maintenance workers for project installations or ongoing site support. We clarify trade experience, tools, and any required qualifications.

cards.title: Contract and project teams
cards.body: Plan a team for a defined project period, a new work package, or changing site demand. The proposal records the roles, headcount, and planned dates.

cards.title: Supervisors and team leads
cards.body: Where the scope calls for it, supervisors can coordinate daily attendance, task allocation, and communication with your project management team.

cards.title: Mobilisation coordination
cards.body: Coordinate candidate approval, document collection, site induction planning, and joining dates with the people responsible at your project.

why.title: Roles defined before sourcing
why.body: We start with the work package, trade mix, site location, and expected programme. That gives your team a chance to confirm experience and headcount before profiles are reviewed.

why.title: A plan that follows project stages
why.body: Construction demand can change as a project moves from preparation to installation and finishing. We discuss start dates and duration so proposed staffing matches the phase you are planning.

why.title: Clear site communication
why.body: A named contact, agreed attendance process, and route for raising site issues help keep coordination clear after workers arrive. We confirm these responsibilities as part of the mobilisation plan.

why.title: Documented scope and costs
why.body: The written proposal sets out roles, quantities, duration, rates, and included services. Your team can review the assumptions and exclusions before approving the mobilisation.

steps.title: Share your project brief
steps.body: Tell us the trades, headcount, location, shifts, expected start date, and project duration.

steps.title: Review the workforce plan
steps.body: We confirm open questions and share available profiles, timing assumptions, and a written quote.

steps.title: Approve and prepare
steps.body: Your team reviews candidates and confirms site access, induction, documents, and joining arrangements.

steps.title: Mobilise and coordinate
steps.body: We coordinate the agreed start and workforce administration with your designated project contact.

faqs.q: Which construction roles can you source?
faqs.a: Roles may include general helpers, masons, carpenters, steel fixers, painters, electricians, plumbers, and technicians. The brief helps us confirm which roles and experience levels fit the project.

faqs.q: Can you provide contract staff for a specific project period?
faqs.a: We can discuss project-based and contract requirements. The planned duration, headcount, and service scope are recorded in the proposal.

faqs.q: What information do you need before quoting?
faqs.a: Share the job descriptions, quantities, site location, working hours, expected start date, duration, and any qualifications or access requirements.

faqs.q: Who handles site induction and safety instructions?
faqs.a: We agree responsibilities with your project contact before mobilisation. Your site team should provide the project-specific induction and safety instructions required at the location.

faqs.q: Can staffing numbers change during the project?
faqs.a: Tell us about expected changes when sharing the programme. We can discuss how additions, reductions, and notice periods should be handled in the agreement.

faqs.q: When can workers start?
faqs.a: Start dates depend on role availability, candidate approval, documentation, site access, and any required approvals. We confirm a realistic schedule before you approve.

payroll-hr-outsourcing.title: Payroll & HR Outsourcing
payroll-hr-outsourcing.subtitle: A consistent monthly payroll process with organised HR records and clear approvals.
payroll-hr-outsourcing.intro: Payroll and HR outsourcing gives an employer structured support for recurring administrative work without relying on scattered spreadsheets and last-minute corrections. We first map your current payroll calendar, employee data, approval steps, and reporting needs. Then we agree what information your team provides, who checks changes, and which tasks are included in the service. Depending on the agreed scope, support can cover payroll preparation, payslip administration, attendance inputs, employee file organisation, and coordination of wage payment documentation. We work with employers who want clearer monthly routines and a dependable point of contact. The employer remains responsible for approving payroll information and confirming applicable legal and financial obligations with its qualified advisers.

cards.title: Monthly payroll preparation
cards.body: Organise approved salary inputs, additions, deductions, and changes into a repeatable monthly payroll workflow with clear cut-off dates.

cards.title: Payslip administration
cards.body: Prepare payslip records using the approved payroll information and agreed format, with a route for your team to review exceptions before release.

cards.title: Attendance and leave inputs
cards.body: Coordinate attendance, overtime, leave, and other approved inputs with your designated managers so payroll changes have a clear source.

cards.title: WPS documentation support
cards.body: Help organise payroll information and wage documentation for your internal process. Scope and responsibility for submission are confirmed before work begins.

cards.title: Employee record coordination
cards.body: Keep agreed employee records and payroll changes organised, with access and handling procedures defined by your company.

cards.title: Payroll reporting and queries
cards.body: Provide agreed monthly summaries and a contact path for payroll questions, corrections, and items that need employer approval.

why.title: A repeatable monthly calendar
why.body: Defined cut-off dates and approval steps help managers understand when changes must be submitted and when payroll information is ready for review.

why.title: Clear accountability for changes
why.body: Each payroll input should have an owner and an approval path. We agree who supplies, checks, and approves information so adjustments are easier to trace.

why.title: Organised records
why.body: A consistent approach to employee data and payroll documents makes it easier to respond to internal questions and prepare information for authorised reviewers.

why.title: A service matched to your operation
why.body: We confirm headcount, payroll frequency, locations, systems, and reporting needs before agreeing scope. You receive a defined service rather than an unclear list of tasks.

steps.title: Map your current process
steps.body: Share your payroll calendar, employee groups, approval owners, and recurring challenges.

steps.title: Agree the service scope
steps.body: We document the inputs, tasks, reports, cut-off dates, access, and responsibilities included.

steps.title: Prepare and review payroll
steps.body: Your team supplies and approves changes; we prepare the agreed payroll materials and flag exceptions for review.

steps.title: Close the month
steps.body: We provide the agreed outputs and record unresolved items or process changes for the next cycle.

faqs.q: What payroll tasks can be outsourced?
faqs.a: The scope can include payroll preparation, payslips, approved attendance inputs, record coordination, and agreed reporting. We define the included tasks in writing before starting.

faqs.q: Who approves the salary and attendance information?
faqs.a: Your designated employer contacts remain responsible for verifying and approving employee data, attendance, pay changes, and other payroll inputs.

faqs.q: Do you submit WPS files for us?
faqs.a: WPS support depends on the agreed scope, access, and employer process. We clarify who prepares, reviews, and submits each item before work begins.

faqs.q: Can you work with our existing payroll system?
faqs.a: We can review your current process and system requirements. Compatibility and any access needed should be confirmed during scoping.

faqs.q: How do you handle payroll corrections?
faqs.a: We agree a correction window and approval path. Changes are logged and processed according to the service calendar and information provided by your authorised contacts.

faqs.q: What employee information do you need?
faqs.a: Only the data required for the agreed service. We define secure sharing, access, and retention expectations with your company before collecting employee records.

payroll-hr-outsourcing.audience: For employers that want a consistent payroll cycle, organised employee records, and clearly approved monthly inputs.
